title: Implement JSIR/CASCADE normalization worker
description: Add a Worker-backed JavaScript IR normalization stage for JSVMP and heavy obfuscation pipelines.
action: Add `jsir.cascade.normalize` as a Worker-backed static normalization tool that emits JavaScript IR, dispatcher summaries, and handler candidate artifacts.
implementation: Accept normalized JS artifacts from REstringer or JSIMPLIFIER, plus optional profile evidence.
Emit IR artifact, control-flow regions, dispatcher model, handler candidates, and unresolved dynamic hazards.
Route high-confidence bytecode VM evidence to `jsvmp.bytecode.plan` and future JSVMP workers.

criteria: Fixture backend output produces a javascript_ir artifact and dispatcher summary.
Malformed IR output is rejected with structured errors.
JSVMP-heavy samples do not claim full recovery; they emit handler candidates and next tools.
convergence.definition_of_done: The JS suite has a real IR normalization worker that bridges string/expression cleanup to JSVMP recovery planning.

risks: IR schema drift can break downstream JSVMP tools unless contract tests pin the artifact format.
Some transformations may require semantic execution and must remain blocked.
